'''North Massir''' is a sub-continent located in the southern hemisphere. It is bordered the [[South Massir]] and [[West Massir]] to the south, [[Eashor]] and [[Vihsanna Ocean]] to the west, the [[Diairesi Sea]] to the north, and the [[Kera Sea]] to the east. The continent covers around {{convert|5,790,442|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}} of land, making it the 9th largest sub-continent in the world, with a total of about 197,726,757 as of 1765, making it also the 14th largest sub-continent by population.
